meta.title: Francisco López — Senior Product Manager
meta.description: Senior Product Manager with 10+ years in B2B and B2C SaaS, and one exit (TheTool → AppRadar). From discovery to data: I research, prototype, build and measure.

brandKit.name: Brand Kit
brandKit.desc: The identity: the logo and its geometry, the two-layer palette, the typography and the rules that govern its use.

designSystem.name: Design System
designSystem.desc: The skeleton: grid, layout tokens, vertical rhythm, typography, motion and measured accessibility.

accesibilidad.name: Accessibility
accesibilidad.desc: The public statement: the conformance level the site meets and how to report a problem.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.description: I use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used and improve it. You can accept all, reject them, or choose what you allow.

prefs.title: Cookie preferences
prefs.intro: Choose which categories you allow. Necessary cookies can't be turned off.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Essential for the site to work. They store no personal data and need no consent.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Measure in aggregate how the site is used (page views, clicks) to improve it. Google Analytics.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Allow personalising and measuring campaigns. Not used today; the control stays available in case they're enabled.

contacto.title: Let's talk
contacto.intro: If product sits at the core of your company and you're building genuinely great experiences for your users —through discovery, applied AI and data—, I think we'd be a good fit. Senior Product Manager with 10+ years in B2B and B2C SaaS, happy working remote or hybrid, based in Spain. Email or call me directly.
